calculation_steps: Enumerate 20 common, three old-only and seven new-only oriented simplices.
Build signed S3 and C2 representation matrices; solve YRo=RnY exactly.
Base-only rank18/21 gives Hom dimension3 but all image in one sign line, so rank Y≤1.
Full group rank20/21 gives unique odd top channel; old apex-even dimension2 has no new-only counterpart.
Check primitive squared norms2 and3, rational square obstruction2/3; construct R-algebraic two-memory isometry and verify Gram I3.
